description: Type the HTTP 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION returned when deleting a QA scorecard's only revision. It surfaced as a generic BadRequest, so callers matched on the message.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The revision is the scorecard's only revision and cannot be deleted on its own (HTTP 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION); it goes away with the scorecard. Not retryable.

message.includes: only revision of a scorecard cannot be deleted
